messages:
maria: Heads-up — we need a manual cutover for the IAM role bindings in prod during the 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. This touches cross-account peering, so planning for a short evacuation and rollback path.
joel: Ack. Which resources are we targeting?
maria: Mainly module.networking.aws_iam_role.peering_role and module.platform.aws_iam_policy.bindings. Also pinning provider to avoid drift.
ash: (bot note) Reminder: change window registered in calendar.
ash: sorry, typo — meant as a calendar bot.
ash: :calendar:
joel: who will run the apply? I can take the A1 slot if kevin wants B1 for validation.
kevin: I can validate post-apply. Will monitor routes and peering health.
maria: plan: preflight `terraform plan -var=\"env=prod\" -target=module.networking` on staging replica, then serial apply in prod with traffic shadow off. If anything weird, immediately revert provider pin and rollback policy.
joel: Add the deploybot backoff signal so deploybot doesn't auto-merge during the window.
maria: Good call. I'll disable auto-deploy and post the deploybot command.
deploybot: Preflight checks: 5/6 passed. Pending: backend lock age > 30m and provider version mismatch.
nash: which provider version are we pinning to?
maria: `required_version = \">= 4.56.0, < 5.0.0\"` in provider.tf and runtime lockfile at `terraform.lock.hcl` (hash bumped).
joel: I'll run the apply, but we need a quick evacuation playbook if peering flaps: 1) detach route announcement (announce blackhole), 2) revert IAM bindings with `terraform apply -target=module.platform -var='evacuate=true'`, 3) restore. Keep steps in chat.
kevin: I'll prepare monitoring queries and a one-click rollback runbook in runbook/ops (I'll attach link after).
maria: Leaving a short snippet here for quick copy:
```
# run from infra/prod
terraform workspace select prod
terraform init
terraform plan -var='env=prod' -target=module.networking
terraform apply -var='env=prod' -target=module.networking -auto-approve
```
joel: When I kick this off I'll tfstate-lock and annotate the change in the release notes: \"IAM peering role pin + policy cleanup\".
deploybot: Action: auto-deploy disabled by @maria for change window 02:00-03:00 UTC.
sre-bot: Oncall pager muted but monitoring channel linked.
ash: quick question — do we need canary split? This is a config-only IAM change, but it affects cross-account access for traffic mirroring.
maria: low risk but we will do a 10m traffic shadow check (shadow disabled by default), then 10% canary for policy binding using staged apply tag. If all good, proceed full.
joel: Got it. I'll start with shadow test at 02:10 UTC and report back in this thread.
kevin: I'll watch latency and peer DNS resolution. If anything >10% error or RTT spike >200ms we abort and run evacuation.
maria: Perfect. I'll post release notes blurb and rollback checklist in 10m. Please ack here when ready. :thumbsup:
joel: Ready.
kevin: Ready.
ash: Ready.
maria: Starting provider pin PR now, will merge just before window.
joel: Copy. Waiting for PR merge then proceed with plan.
deploybot: Deployment note: manual apply required — automatic rollout suppressed.
kevin: After apply, I'll run `aws ec2 describe-vpc-peering-connections` + our adjacency check to confirm reachability; will post results.
maria: thanks all — thread will be used as the live log during the window.
